paper.title: Algorithm 831: Modified Bessel Functions of Imaginary Order and Positive Argument

field: numerics (special functions, Bessel functions of imaginary order)

claim.text: WKTEST Wronskian check, IFAC=2 (scaled functions), maximum over the driver's grid, as printed in the shipped Drivers/Res: 6.814548925149211E-13, absolute tolerance 1e-13

attempt: Reproduced. The authors' Fortran 77 sources compile as shipped with gfortran -O2 (Drivers/wktest.f with Src/src.f, Src/airy.f, Src/d1mach.f; no edits, no flags beyond -O2; original attempt succeeded). The driver writes its report to TESTF.DAT (its OPEN on unit 1). Two passes (original binary in its build directory; the same binary in a clean directory) give the same TESTF.DAT byte-for-byte and the same maximum, 6.8156591481738360E-13. |ours - paper| = 1.1e-16, inside the registered absolute tolerance 1e-13. The maximum is below 1e-12, the paper's 'close to 1e-12' scale for this grid. Note on the rest of the output: the shipped Drivers/Res and our TESTF.DAT differ in several entries of the earlier per-point error table (for example X=50, A=550, first error column: 0.399680289D-14 shipped vs 0.152100554D-12 ours; X=50, A=60, second column: 0.122124533D-14 vs 0.144328993D-14). These are not the registered claim; they are recorded, not judged, and the table is not compared further here. Replay (G5) not yet run.
